# s4communication_communication_arrangement (List Resource)

Lists communication arrangements. Use with `terraform query`, optionally with `-generate-config-out` to write configuration with import blocks; the generated configuration includes the services and properties that are imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List the arrangements of one communication system for a scenario.
# Generated configuration includes the arrangement's outbound services and the
# properties that have values, the same as an import.
list "s4communication_communication_arrangement" "ext_api" {
  provider = s4communication

  config {
    communication_system_id   = "EXT_API_SYSTEM"
    communication_scenario_id = "SAP_COM_0008"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `communication_scenario_id` (String) Only list arrangements of this communication scenario, e.g. `SAP_COM_0008`.
- `communication_system_id` (String) Only list arrangements of the communication system with this ID.
